messages:
maria-cs: FYI — ClearWave (trial -> paid last quarter) dropped ~45% weekly API calls since 3/1. Procurement handed to CFO last week, they asked for cost/ROI. I also heard from their CS rep they're running a PilotAI PoC this week. Need triage and a tight playbook. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

jordan-csm: Can you paste the top-line usage numbers and any error spikes? Do we have their renewal date?

maria-cs: Renewal 2026-07-12. Quick numbers from usage dashboard: 
```
2026-02-20 - 2,400 calls
2026-02-27 - 2,150 calls
2026-03-05 - 1,300 calls
2026-03-12 - 1,050 calls
2026-03-18 - 980 calls
```
No obvious error rate increase in logs. Most drop is in generative endpoints (chat).

ash-dev: do we have latency regressions or throttling on their API key? I can check the token-level traces. Also any feature flags toggled?

maria-cs: No feature flags changed on our side. Latency stable per console. Action items: check token traces + confirm whether they switched to a cheaper model client-side or gated traffic.

tyler-sa: From solutions side — CFO ask means cost justification. Recommend: 1) a quick "cost vs quality" delta showing they can save by routing low-priority requests to a smaller model, 2) offer a 30d discounted Reserved trial on Dedicated to lock throughput and show unit economics, 3) run a joint technical review with their engineering + our SEs. I can own the cost model slide.

maria-cs: +1 to the reserved trial, but watch legal/finance approval. Also need a short competitive note on PilotAI — do we know their angle? Are they promising lower cost, or features?

sam-psc: PilotAI is pitching a direct replacement for our chat with a custom prompt engine — their claim is 30% cheaper per token via aggressive quantization and aggressive batching. We have customer notes in the CRM about them testing reranking too.

ash-dev: I pulled token traces: no throttles, but the client appears to be hitting a new model param: model=rwq-1.1-4bit in their requests since 3/04. Looks like they toggled model variant. That would reduce cost but might drop quality. I can export a sample request/response set for analysis.

maria-cs: Please export and drop in the shared folder. I'll prepare a short report for CFO: 1-pager with usage trend, estimated monthly spend delta, and suggested pilot (Reserved 30d).

tyler-sa: I'll draft the technical review invite. Proposed times: Wed 3/24 10am PT or Thu 3/25 2pm PT. Who should join from our side? SE + CSM + product PM?

maria-cs: SE (tyler), jordan (CSM), legal or finance if trial needs contract tweak, and ash (dev) for traces. I'll invite their engineering lead + CFO + procurement.

ops-bot: [automated] Created folder: /shared/customer-success/clearwave/triage-1843210000 and set initial perms for participants.

maria-cs: Thanks. One more ask — can someone prepare a 5-slide competitive brief: PilotAI claims, risks, our counterpoints (quality, rollback/fallback), and a quick economics calc. Need by EOD Mon.

tyler-sa: I can take that — will include token-cost math and an example prompt that shows quality delta.

jordan-csm: I'll coordinate the invite and outreach to their CFO. Also will share recent health check notes.

maria-cs: Great. If anyone sees usage spike down further, ping here immediately. Goal: contain churn risk before renewal cycle. :thumbsup:
